title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:SIDEWALL (1,762 affected)
summary: DEFECTIVE TIRES HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH A HOLE IN THE UPPER SIDEWALL OF THE DOT SERIAL SIDE OF THE TIRE.

title: IC CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL (2,950 affected)
summary: THE REAR EMERGENCY EXIT DOOR DOES NOT HAVE AN EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL. CONSEQUENTLY, THE DOOR DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."

title: C.T.I. INCORPORATED: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (151 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER'S SAFETY BELT DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: ROVER GROUP, LIMITED: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (1,082 affected)
summary: THE CERTIFICATION LABELS CONTAIN INCORRECT INFORMATION CONCERNING THE VEHICLE WEIGHT RATINGS AND TIRE/RIM SPECIFICATIONS. THE CERTIFICATION LABELS ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH 49 CFR PART 567 AND FMVSS 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (10,629 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK CAGE ASSEMBLY BOLTS MOUNTING THE VERTICAL STRAPS TO THE HORIZONTAL ANGLE WERE ASSEMBLED WITH THE THREADED END OF THE BOLTS FACING THE FUEL TANK.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER AND WASHER (75,863 affected)
summary: CERTAIN WINDSHIELD WIPER COMPONENTS ARE SUBJECT TO PREMATURE FAILURE DUE TO INSUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO FUNCTION UNDER HIGH LOAD LEVELS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (17,000 affected)
summary: THE WELDING ATTACHMENTS OF THE FRONT FRAME RAILS TO THE FLOOR PAN SHEET METAL MAY NOT BE PROPERLY WELDED.

title: LAG MOTORCOACH USA: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:STANDARD:MANUAL (121 affected)
summary: THE MANUAL TRANSMISSION MOUNT ON THESE BUSES CAN BREAK CAUSING DAMAGE TO THE ENGINE'S FLYWHEEL HOUSING.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:MATTRESS (16 affected)
summary: THE BURN RATE FOR THE MATTRESS TICKING EXCEEDS THE 4 INCHES PER MINUTE REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 302, "FLAMMABILITY OF INTERIOR MATERIALS."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (1,200 affected)
summary: LOCK NUTS USED TO HOLD THE LEFT AND RIGHT FRONT AXLES TO THE SUSPENSION STRUTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY MANUFACTURED. THE LOCK NUTS MAY BREAK AND CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE AXLE FROM THE SUSPENSION STRUTS.

title: NATIONAL MOTOR COACH CO.: EQUIPMENT:CARRIER:SPARE TIRE (95 affected)
summary: THE HINGES ATTACHING THE WHEEL CARRIER TO THE MOTORHOME CAN FAIL, RESULTING IN THE WHEEL AND CARRIER SEPARATING FROM THE MOTORHOME.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: EXHAUST SYSTEM (88 affected)
summary: THESE MOTORHOMES ARE SUSCEPTIBLE TO ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES. THE CAUSE IS NOT LIMITED TO ONE COMPONENT OR SYSTEM.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (2,848 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE HOSES WERE MANUFACTURED INCORRECTLY, AND DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 106, "BRAKE HOSES."

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS (3,300 affected)
summary: THE TWO REARWARD FRONT SUSPENSION FRAME MOUNTING BRACKETS CAN FRACTURE.

title: REESE PRODUCTS, INC: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (670 affected)
summary: THE WELD ON THE RECEIVER UNIT OF THE TRAILER HITCH CAN BREAK.

title: HIGH COUNTRY ALUMINUM PRODUCTS. LLC: EQUIPMENT:OWNERS MANUAL INFORMATION (399 affected)
summary: AN INCORRECT INFORMATION PROVIDED IN THE OWNER'S MANUAL FOR THE SLIDE-IN TRUCK CAMPERS COULD CAUSE VEHICLE OWNERS TO OVERLOAD THE AXLES ON THE PICKUP TRUCKS. THE MANUALS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 126, "TRUCK-CAMPER LOADING."

title: CITROEN CARS CORPORATION: BRAKES:SERVICE BRAKES (7 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLES ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH SEVERAL FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARDS. FMVSS 101 AND 105: THE WORD "BRAKE" IS NOT DISPLAYED IN CLEAR VIEW OF THE DRIVER ON THE ILLUMINATED MAP INDICATOR LAMP. FMVSS 208: THE DURATION OF THE ILLUMINATION OF THE SEAT BELT WARNING LIGHT MAY FALL SHORT OF THE REQUIRED 60 SECONDS AFTER THE IGNITION SWITCH IS MOVED TO THE "ON" OR "START" POSITION. FMVSS 209: THE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT IDENTIFICATION LABEL DISPLAYING THE MANUFACTURER'S NAME, MODEL, AND DATE OF MANUFACTURE IS MISSING.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH (34 affected)
summary: FINAL STAGE MANUFACTURING REQUIRED THE POWER DISTRIBUTION AND IGNITION SYSTEM WIRING TO BE REROUTED. THIS WIRING CHANGE LEFT THESE CIRCUITS UNPROTECTED AGAINST HIGH ELECTRICAL CURRENTS.

title: KOLCRAFT ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (307,017 affected)
summary: THE TONGUE OF THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY CAN CORRODE. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS." ALSO, THE LABEL WITH USE AND SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS IS MISSING FROM THE PLAYSKOOL MODEL.
